integrity: The all-\(n\) upper bound is a direct combinatorial proof; finite enumeration is used only as a replayable consistency check at the exceptional lengths.
The closest current source gives only the general upper bound \(S_q(n,n-3)\le q+\binom q2\) for \(n\ge q+2\) and does not state this exact ternary formula.
No independent audit or independent validation is claimed.
limitations: The exact formula is proved only for alphabet size three and the regime \(t=n-3\).
